onb_1_title: WhatsApp pe lead aata hai. Phir bhool jaate ho?
onb_1_sub: Log Insta ya WhatsApp pe price poochte hain, phir unki chat neeche dab jaati hai. Hum yaad rakhenge.
onb_2_title: App kholo. Dekho aaj kise ping karna hai.
onb_2_sub: Ek hi list. Aaj, overdue, is hafte. Na dashboard, na jhanjhat.
onb_3_pill: Tap karo → chat khulegi, message tayyar
onb_3_title: Tap karke message. WhatsApp ya Insta, ready hai.
onb_3_sub: App aapka message type karke chat kholta hai. Offline-first. Aapka data sirf phone pe rahega.
today_catchup_banner: Aapke {days} din ke follow-up chhoot gaye — abhi dekho
empty_today_title: Chai pi lo, koi follow-up nahi.
empty_today_sub: Aaj koi follow-up due nahi. Agla DM aaye to lead jodo.
pro_card_today_body: Free plan pe {used} / 50 use ho rahe hain. Pro lo — unlimited leads, smart follow-up suggestions aur CSV export.
field_interest_placeholder: jaise: Red velvet 1kg, eggless. Budget ₹1200. Wedding cake ka reference bheja.
field_interest_hint: Hindi/Hinglish chalega — jaise marzi type karo.
tap_to_schedule: Set karne ke liye tap karo
followup_template: Hi {firstName}! {interest} ke baare mein follow-up kar rahi/raha hoon. Abhi bhi chahiye? 😊
empty_search_sub: Doosra filter try karo ya search clear karo.
pro_card_settings_body: Unlimited leads, advanced filters, CSV / JSON export aur smart morning summary.
settings_reminders_sub: Roz ki list — kise follow-up karna hai
settings_morning_summary_sub: App kholte hi "Aaj 5 leads ko follow-up karna hai"
settings_backup_export_sub: Leads ko JSON / CSV mein save karo
settings_footer: FollowUp Buddy v1.0 · made in India 🇮🇳 · Sirf is phone pe stored
snack_lead_saved: ✓ Lead save hui · reminder {days} din baad
settings_seed_demo_sub: Screenshots ke liye demo data — aapki abhi ki leads replace hongi
seed_confirm: Isse aapki saari leads 14 demo leads se replace ho jaayengi. Aage badhein?
settings_clear_data_sub: Is phone se har lead, note aur setting hata deta hai
clear_data_confirm: Is phone se saari leads, notes aur settings delete karein? Yeh wapas nahi hoga.
snack_ig_opened: Message copy hua · Instagram khul raha hai
pro_renew_note: Auto-renew hota hai. Google Play mein kabhi bhi cancel karo.
pro_unavailable: Pro sirf FollowUp Buddy ke Google Play version mein milta hai.
pro_active: Is account pe Pro active hai. Shukriya!
purchase_failed: Purchase poora nahi hua. Phir try karo.
no_purchase_found: Is Google account pe koi active Pro subscription nahi mila.
notify_mode_periodic: Is time roz reminder, app band ho tab bhi (Google Play se install kiya ho)
notify_mode_open: Reminder sirf tab dikhega jab app is browser mein khula ho. Roz ke asli alarm ke liye Google Play se install karo.
notify_mode_none: Yeh browser notification nahi dikha sakta
notify_permission_denied: Notifications band hain — phone settings mein allow karo
settings_quiet_hours_sub: {start} se {end} ke beech koi reminder nahi
pipeline_hint: Nateeja log karne pe lead aage badhti hai: message bheja → Contact kiya, Reply aaya → Interested, Order mila → Order mila.
snack_replied: Note kiya · lead ne reply diya
stats_settings_sub: Mahine ke orders, best tags, best source
stats_best_tags: Best tags · orders ke hisaab se
stats_source_detail: {leads} mein se {orders} leads ne order kiya
stats_empty: Abhi koi order nahi. Kisi lead ko ₹ value ke saath Order mila mark karo, yahan dikhega.
stats_footnote: Sirf is phone ki leads se gina gaya. Order value = Order mila mark karte waqt jo aapne likha.
templates_settings_sub: {count} saved · har tag ke liye alag opener
templates_intro: 3 tak openers likho aur kisi tag se jodo. Lead pe WhatsApp ya Instagram dabane pe, template wala pehla tag message tay karta hai. Bhejte aap hi ho.
templates_limit_note: Yahi maximum hai ({max}). Aur jodne ke liye kisi ko badlo ya hatao.
templates_share_note: "sent with FollowUp Buddy" line hamesha end mein judti hai.
templates_delete_confirm: Yeh template hatayein? Ise use karne wale tags default message pe laut jaayenge.
snack_template_invalid: Message khaali nahi ho sakta (max 300 characters)
snack_share_prefilled: Aapne jo share kiya usse bhar diya — check karke save karo
snack_snooze_bad_date: Aaj ke baad ki date chuno
catalogue_settings_sub: {count} / {max} products · kisi bhi lead se product card bhejo
catalogue_intro: Aapke best sellers, price aur photo ke saath. Lead pe "Product card bhejo" dabao — share karne layak image + message banta hai.
catalogue_photo_hint: Phone pe hi 800 px mein chhoti hoti hai. Isi device pe rehti hai.
catalogue_delete_confirm: Yeh product aur uski photo hatayein?
catalogue_privacy_note: Photos sirf is phone pe rehti hain. Bahar sirf us card mein jaati hain jo aap khud share karte ho.
card_send_sub: Product chuno → app 1080×1350 image + message banata hai. Share aap khud karte ho.
card_no_products: Abhi koi product nahi. Pehle Catalogue mein kuch jodo.
snack_card_shared: Card aapki share sheet ko de diya
snack_card_downloaded: Card downloads mein save · message tayyar
cloud_settings_sub: Isi phone pe encrypted · doosre phone pe restore karo
cloud_unavailable_body: Is version mein encrypted backup server on nahi hai. Backup & export mein JSON backup aaj bhi kaam karta hai.
cloud_intro: Aapki leads isi phone pe ek passphrase se encrypt hoti hain jo sirf aap jaante ho. Server pe ek random vault code ke neeche scrambled data rehta hai jo woh padh nahi sakta. Sirf Pro, aur vault banane tak band.
cloud_passphrase_hint: Kam se kam 8 characters. Bhool gaye to backup koi wapas nahi la sakta — hum bhi nahi.
cloud_vault_code_hint: 32 characters, vault banane ke baad dikhta hai. Passphrase ke saath sambhaal ke rakho.
cloud_auto_sync_sub: App khula ho to change ke 30 sec baad upload
cloud_forget_confirm: Is phone se vault code aur key hatayein? Aapki leads yahin rahengi; cloud copy tab tak rahegi jab tak doosre phone se na hatao.
cloud_delete_remote_confirm: Server se encrypted copy hatayein? Is vault wale doosre phones sync hona band kar denge.
cloud_conflict_confirm: Cloud copy is phone se nayi hai. Abhi is phone mein merge karein?
cloud_restore_confirm: Cloud copy ko is phone mein merge karein? Maujooda leads rahengi; naye changes jeetenge.
cloud_key_note: Aapke passphrase se bani key isi phone pe rehti hai taaki sync dobara poochhe bina chale.
snack_cloud_failed: Cloud sync nahi hua — baad mein phir try karo
snack_cloud_not_found: Is code ka koi vault nahi
snack_cloud_too_large: Backup 2 MB se zyada — kuch photos ya leads hatao
team_settings_sub: Vault ke zariye yeh list ek assistant se share karo
team_intro: Ek vault, do phone. Aapka assistant apne phone mein Cloud backup kholke "Restore / judo" dabata hai aur aapka vault code + passphrase daalta hai. Phir dono phone usi encrypted vault se sync hote hain; har note aur message mein likha rehta hai kis phone ne kiya.
team_device_name_hint: History mein dikhta hai, jaise "Anjali" ya "Shop phone"
team_invite_body: Unhe neeche ka vault code do aur passphrase saamne batao — chat pe kabhi nahi. Dono jiske paas hon, woh yeh list padh aur badal sakta hai.
team_no_vault: Pehle Cloud backup mein vault banao.
team_merge_rule: Dono phone ek hi lead badlein to naya change jeetta hai; dono phone ke notes rehte hain.
self_digest_title: Aaj ki list mujhe WhatsApp pe bhejo
self_digest_sub: Aapke apne number ki chat khulti hai, list pehle se typed. Send aap dabate ho.
self_digest_no_phone: Pehle Profile mein apna WhatsApp number jodo
profile_phone_hint: Sirf "Aaj ki list mujhe bhejo" ke liye. Kabhi share nahi hota.
reactivate_body: {count} leads 30+ din se chup hain. Ek festive hello aksar unhe wapas laata hai.
reactivate_confirm: {count} chup leads pe kal subah 9 baje ka follow-up lagayein? Message har ek ko aap hi karoge.
snack_reactivated: {count} leads kal ki list mein wapas
